profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
• Experienced engineering executive that still has a passion for software development
• Proven track record of successfully completing projects on time and within budget
• Able to take high-level concepts and quickly visualize the potential technical and architectural hurdles
• Enthusiastic leader who enjoys researching new technologies
• Demonstrated ability to quickly grasp new concepts and technical skills
• Extensive experience with IVR and unified messaging systems

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead technical initiatives and engineering best practices across the People Tech organization to drive system reliability, automation, and continuous innovation.

- Engineering Excellence: Drive automated testing, site reliability engineering (SRE), system monitoring, and SLO adoption.
- AI Innovation: Lead engineering teams in developing custom AI skills and workflows to automate testing and modern engineering practices.
- Leadership & Visibility: Compile and deliver key operational metrics to Senior Leadership (SLT) to inform strategic tech decisions.

positions.title: VP, Engineering
positions.description:
•	Lead and managed a globally distributed team of software engineers and QA professionals.
•	Actively worked with Java, Python, PostgreSQL, REST, JSON.
•	Architected and implemented the BetrMeetings product suite, supporting Windows, Mac OS, iOS, Android, and web platforms.
•	Personally developed and deployed RESTful microservices in Java (Tomcat) with Cassandra and PostgreSQL, hosted on AWS EC2 and EKS with Fargate.
•	Integrated Jenkins & GitLab CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment and testing.
•	Collaborated with the CEO and Product Management to define the technology roadmap.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Python

positions.title: Director, Development - Advanced R&D
positions.description: Implemented a data layer abstraction over Apache Cassandra, a NoSQL database.  This layer allowed applications to define schemas in XML including dimensions for real-time metrics.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description:
Defined and enforced software development standards and tools within the organization. Provided sales support including pre-sales and RFP responses.

Created Android and Windows Mobile visual voicemail applications that integrated with IBM’s Unified Messaging platform.  Created a full SOA interface to IBM's Unified Messaging platform. This was a J2EE web application that has since been deployed on WebSphere and Tomcat.

Architected and developed the Caller Connect Enterprise Dashboard product which provides an enterprise-wide view of the customer’s Caller Connect systems. Technologies used include Axis and Hibernate accessing DB2, Informix, and PostgreSQL databases.

Created the VoiceRite Caller Connect desktop application using C++/wxWidgets. This talked to a backend server over sockets. The application ran on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X from a single source code base.

Designed and built a middleware layer that was used by a VoiceXML IVR to access backend SOAP WebServices for a financial services company in the Fortune 500. This layer was comprised of two J2EE web applications hosted on multiple Tomcat servers. Technologies used included Axis, XMLBeans, and iBatis accessing an Oracle database.

Designed and built a Name Resolution WebService that can access multiple repositories using a plug-in based architected. Technologies used included Axis, XMLBeans, and Hibernate accessing DB2, Informix, and PostgreSQL databases

Designed and built a highly-scalable middleware platform in C++ and Java for integrating a Windows desktop application with IBM’s Unified Messaging for WebSphere Voice Response. This was deployed at a Fortune 500 company that had over 3,000,000 voice mailboxes.

Managed a $900,000 project with a team of 6 developers in the creation of a multi-tier, J2EE based unified messaging system. The system consisted of HTML, WML, and VoiceXML interfaces.  Managed the entire life cycle of the project through to completion.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
Lead a team of developers in the creation of IBM’s unified messaging system, Message Center. Responsible for the entire software development life cycle. Developed several multi-process DirectTalk
for AIX custom servers as part of the development effort. Successfully brought the project to completion on schedule.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Developed several portions of the voicemail system, DirectTalkMail that was installed at IBM’s worldwide corporate headquarters in Armonk, NY and at many other IBM sites throughout the world. This included writing several custom servers in C and writing DirectTalk for AIX state tables.

Responsible for the installation and support of several DirectTalkMail and DirectTalk for AIX systems throughout the U.S. 

Managed a team of 5 programmers in the development of a unified messaging system on an OS/2 platform. Architected the entire system. 

Designed and developed a low-level multithreaded messaging API in C using ODBC to connect to an IBM DB2 database. Designed and developed several TCP/IP socket based server, and client processes. Developed the VPIM interface which included implementing the SMTP standard, and processing MIME messages. Worked with leading edge Computer Telephony technologies.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Developed Oracle based applications using SQL*Forms, SQL*Plus, and PL/SQL. NCR UNIX V.4 administration and TCP/IP networking support.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: NCR UNIX V.4 support. C++ Windows software development

projects.title: Hammerhead - Genesys Data Layer
projects.description:
- Development of prototype of the Data Layer that provides a one-stop solution for the data needs of different Genesys applications, and allows easier interoperability between applications
    - Implemented the module responsible for creation, update and validation of in-memory data objects and meta-models 
    - Designed and developed algorithms for efficient and real-time metrics computation using graph data structures
